fullPassage: The concept of overtourism rests on a particular assumption about people and places common in tourism studies and the social sciences in general. Both are seen as clearly defined and demarcated. People are framed as bounded social actors either playing the role of hosts or guests. Places, in a similar way, are treated as stable containers with clear boundaries. Hence, places can be full of tourists and thus suffer from overtourism. But what does it mean for a place to be full of people? Indeed, there are examples of particular attractions that have limited capacity and where there is actually no room for more visitors. This is not least the case with some man-made constructions such as the Eiffel Tower. However, with places such as cities, regions or even whole countries being promoted as destinations and described as victims of overtourism, things become more complex. What is excessive or out of proportion is highly relative and might be more related to other aspects than physical capacity, such as natural degradation and economic leakages (not to mention politics and local power dynamics).

✅ ② (A) 공간, 여지 — (B) 방: (A)는 방문객을 위한 공간이 없다는 뜻, (B)는 침실인 방 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 회의실 — (B) 넓이: (A)는 회의실이 아님
❌ ④ (A) 넓이 — (B) 여지: (B)는 '여지'가 아니라 '방'

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "something that you accept as true or certain without proof"

det.korean: 증거 없이 사실로 받아들이는 것 = assumption(가정, 추정)
det.analysis:
❌ ① degradation(악화): 상태의 저하이지 가정 아님
❌ ② capacity(수용력): 능력·수용력이지 가정 아님
✅ ③ assumption(가정): 증거 없이 참으로 받아들이는 것 — 정의 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ boundary(경계): 구분·경계선이지 가정 아님
det.tip: assumption = 가정, 추정 (something taken for granted without proof)

questions.passage: Both are seen as clearly __________ (define) and demarcated. People are framed as bounded social actors either playing the role of hosts or guests.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 'are seen as clearly ___ and demarcated'에서 and로 demarcated(과거분사)와 병렬. 수동·분사 자리이므로 define → defined(과거분사). 'clearly defined and demarcated' = 명확히 정의되고 구분된
det.tip: define(v. 정의하다) → defined(정의된, 과거분사) → definition(n. 정의)

questions.passage: But what does it mean for a place to be full of people? What is __________ (excess) or out of proportion is highly relative and might be more related to other aspects than physical capacity.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 'What is ___ or out of proportion is highly relative'에서 주격보어 자리. 형용사구 out of proportion과 or로 병렬되므로 형용사가 필요. excess(명사) → excessive(형용사). = 무엇이 과도한지

questions.passage: The concept of overtourism rests on a particular assumption about people and places common in tourism studies and the social sciences in general. Both are seen as clearly defined and demarcated. People are framed as bounded social actors either playing the role of hosts or guests. Places, in a similar way, are treated as stable containers with clear boundaries. Hence, places can be full of tourists and thus suffer from overtourism. But what does it mean for a place to be full of people? Indeed, there are examples of particular attractions that have limited capacity and where there is actually no room for more visitors. This is not least the case with some man-made constructions such as the Eiffel Tower. However, with places such as cities, regions or even whole countries being promoted as destinations and described as victims of overtourism, things become more complex. What is excessive or __________ is highly relative and might be more related to other aspects than physical capacity, such as natural degradation and economic leakages (not to mention politics and local power dynamics).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① full of energy(활력이 넘치는): 문맥 무관
❌ ② free of charge(무료의): 문맥 무관
❌ ③ short of time(시간이 부족한): 문맥 무관
✅ ④ out of proportion(균형이 안 맞는, 과도한): excessive와 병렬되어 '과도하거나 지나친'을 의미 — 원문 일치 ←정답
det.tip: out of proportion = 균형이 맞지 않는, 과도한 (↔ in proportion)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① far from true(전혀 사실이 아닌): 에펠탑은 수용력이 제한된 명백한 예이므로 반대
✅ ② not least the case(특히 그러한 경우인): 에펠탑 같은 인공 구조물이 '더 이상 공간 없는' 대표적 사례 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ no longer valid(더 이상 유효하지 않은): 사례가 여전히 유효하므로 부적절
❌ ④ beside the point(요점에서 벗어난): 오히려 핵심 사례
det.tip: not least = 특히, 무엇보다도 / this is not least the case = 특히 이 경우에 해당한다
